name: 🔌 Zotero Bridge CLI
description: Operate the Zotero Bridge CLI when exact Zotero commands or structured recovery are needed.

prompts.common: Read SKILL.md first. If the canonical command is unknown, use references/command-catalog.md to map the Zotero task intent to candidates. After selecting a command, read only its matching reference under references/commands/. Never expose bearer tokens. Return one JSON object that preserves the CLI result or structured failure.
